command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
echo '== arm64 from inside: ELF e_machine must be 183 (AArch64) =='
EM=$(od -An -tu1 -j18 -N2 "$(command -v bwa-mem2)" | awk '{print $1 + $2*256}')
echo "e_machine $EM"
test "$EM" -eq 183
bwa-mem2 version
echo '== which SIMD kernel did this build ship? =='
# bwa-mem2 dispatches on CPU features at runtime and names the binary it picked. On x86 that
# is avx512bw/avx2/sse41; on AArch64 there is no AVX at all, so record what it actually uses.
ls /opt/conda/bin/ | grep -i 'bwa-mem2' > kernels.txt || true
cat kernels.txt
echo '== build the index for the whole GRCh38 analysis set =='
T0=$(date +%s)
/usr/bin/time -v bwa-mem2 index GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa > idx.log 2>&1 || bwa-mem2 index GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa > idx.log 2>&1
T1=$(date +%s)
PEAK=$(awk '/Maximum resident set size/{print $6}' idx.log 2>/dev/null || echo NA)
echo "index_wall_s $(( T1 - T0 ))"
ls -l GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.* | awk '{print $5, $9}'
MEM2B=$(du -cb GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.0123 GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.bwt.2bit.64 GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.amb GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.ann GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.pac 2>/dev/null | awk 'END{print $1}')
tar -cf mem2-index.tar GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.0123 GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.bwt.2bit.64 GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.amb GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.ann GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.pac
TARB=$(stat -c%s mem2-index.tar)
{ echo "index_wall_s      $(( T1 - T0 ))"
  echo "peak_rss_kb       $PEAK"
  echo "mem2_index_bytes  $MEM2B"
  echo "tar_bytes         $TARB"
  echo "bwa_index_bytes   5644394452  (.amb+.ann+.bwt+.pac+.sa, for comparison)"
  echo "simd_kernels      $(tr '\n' ' ' < kernels.txt)"
} > index-check.txt
cat index-check.txt
tail -20 idx.log
test "$TARB" -gt 8000000000
echo 'INDEX BUILD OK'
